given: a SKU's stock record at a location carries a combined tracking code
when: a warehouse operator opens the detail view for that SKU
then: the combined tracking code is shown for that SKU's stock at that location

independence.rationale: AC1 covers the per-location rows (location + quantity); AC2 adds the tracking-code display, which can be broken (code missing or blank) while the location rows still render correctly, and vice versa
